page.overview:
Who is Potato?

Potato is a member of the Bonney Pirates. He was once a resident of the Sorbet Kingdom.

After the Summit War of Marineford, he was arrested by Admiral Akainu following his crew's defeat against the Blackbeard Pirates.

Potato is a plump man who keeps his hair scrunched up. He wears a blank tank top and has a tattoo of a rabbit on his shoulder.

Before reaching the Sabaody Archipelago, he wore a white shirt with a black rabbit head design and a leather vest.
